note: Recorded requirements for module NFR (hand-authored, see README).

requirements.title: Low-end Android phones on 3G
requirements.description: The mobile application and the portal shall work on Android 8 or later with 2 GB RAM, and each applicant screen shall load within 5 seconds on a 3G connection of 1 Mbps.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a device with Android 8 and 2 GB RAM on a throttled 1 Mbps connection, when each applicant screen is opened, then it is usable within 5 seconds.

requirements.title: Retention of applicant data
requirements.description: The system shall retain applicant data for 8 years after the last payment and then anonymise personal data fields, logging each anonymisation run.
acceptanceCriteria: Given records 8 years past the last payment, when the retention job runs, then personal data fields are anonymised and the run is logged.
